# Prepare a tender response

You work in sales engineering for Beispiel Hydraulik GmbH, a German hydraulics manufacturer. Prepare one net EUR bid for Wasserverband Musterstadt: Hydraulikzylinder für das Schleusentor Süd (VG-2026-0815). The scenario date is 2026-10-08T09:00:00Z; the tender deadline is 2026-10-30T11:00:00Z.

Collect the tender and its clarifications from the tender portal (Vergabeportal, `tender-portal`), the technical specification from the buyer's supplier portal (Lieferantenportal, `customer-portal`), materials and prices from the internal ERP (`erp`), and discount approvals from the sales mailbox in the webmail (Werkpost, `mail`, bidder mailbox vertrieb@beispiel-hydraulik.example). The websites are in German; obsolete documents and unrelated records are present.

## Rules

1. Quantity: start with the original tender quantity. For each position, use the quantity in the latest dated clarification that changes that position, if any.
2. Requirement: use the requirement referenced by the position in the specification revision marked current. Superseded revisions do not apply.
3. Material: select an active ERP material whose bore, stroke, pressure, mounting and certification all exactly equal that requirement. Blocked materials do not qualify. If any position has no matching active material, submit no_bid.
4. Unit price: use the material's price condition valid on the scenario date, including both validity endpoints. Choose the scale with the highest minimum quantity no greater than the final quantity. Apply the approved discount to that scale price and round the resulting unit price half up to the nearest cent.
5. Discount: use the most recent message from the sales director (leitung@ followed by the bidder's mailbox domain) that approves a discount for this exact tender reference. Approvals for other references and messages from other senders do not apply. If there is no approval, use zero percent.
6. Lead time: use the delivery-from-stock lead time in weeks when stock covers the final quantity; otherwise use the production lead time in weeks.
7. Total: sum each final quantity multiplied by its rounded discounted unit price, then round the total net amount half up to the nearest cent.
8. Decision: submit bid with one entry per tender position, identified by its position number, and currency EUR. If any active matching material is missing, submit no_bid with no positions and a total of zero.


## Additional rules

These refine rules 1, 2, 4, 5, 6 and 7 above. Every submitted quantity is in pieces.

- Partial submission: full credit requires every position, but the bid form lets you explicitly omit unfinished positions (Position auslassen / Teilpunkte). They receive no position points; completed positions retain their independent credit. Review lists the omitted position numbers. You must still sign and submit a bid; saving alone is not scored. A missing active material still calls for no_bid for full correctness; omission is a way to submit incomplete work, not a replacement decision rule.
- Finding records: the specification/data sheet names a Kataloggruppe for each requirement. Search the ERP for that group, then compare candidate attributes. Empty or over-broad searches do not list the catalogue; narrow to at most 20 results. Mail search combines words with AND: use the tender reference plus a subject/topic. Read the appropriate inbox/archive results. Opened pages and selected result sets may be extracted by helpers. Sites and positions can be investigated in parallel; no shared request quota or mandatory site order applies.

4	Each seed is one invented tender on four local websites with their own look (see scenario.py and sites.py). The
5	expected answer comes from oracle.py, so a run gets the same breakdown a sandbox test run shows, for data and
6	layouts the agent has never seen. Nothing here is part of the package, and nothing here may flow back into
7	`agent/` as site knowledge: use a failing seed to find what is too specific in the agent, then fix that in general.
8	
9	From the repo root (`uv run --project agent` gives the agent's Python and Playwright):
10	    uv run --project agent python dev/synth/run.py check --seeds 300      # oracle vs agent/calc.py, form round trip

111	def judge(app: sites.App, expected: dict) -> dict:
112	    """The score of the signed bid, with the form's own traps counted (an alternative offer is not a bid)."""
113	    signed = app.signed
114	    answer = signed and dict(signed["answer"])
115	    if answer and signed["meta"]["offer_type"] == "neben":
116	        answer["decision"] = "alternative_offer"
117	    result = oracle.score(app.world, expected, answer)
118	    if signed:
119	        w = app.world
120	        meta = signed["meta"]
121	        result["form"] = {"own_terms_declared": meta["own_terms"], "omitted": meta["omitted"],
122	                          "extra_rows": meta["extra_rows"], "tan_requests": meta["tan_requests"],
123	                          "discards": meta["discards"],
124	                          "company_ok": meta["company"] == w.company and meta["vat"] == w.vat,
125	                          "contact_ok": meta["email"].casefold() == w.mailbox.casefold()}
126	        result["seconds"] = meta["seconds"]

133	class Client:
134	    """Fills the bid form over plain HTTP with a given answer: proves a scenario's form and scoring work.
135	    It knows the form's field names, so it says nothing about the agent."""
136	
137	    def __init__(self, site: sites.Site, entry: str = ""):
138	        self.site, self.entry = site, entry  # entry: the address of a tender's entry step, when it has one
139	        self.opener = urllib.request.build_opener(urllib.request.HTTPCookieProcessor(CookieJar()))
140	
141	    def call(self, path: str, form: dict | None = None) -> str:
142	        """A page by the address and field names of the sites' code, whatever this seed's sites call them. A
143	        temporary error is asked again; a session that ended is signed in again."""
144	        data = urlencode(form).encode() if form is not None else None
145	        for _ in range(4):
146	            with self.opener.open(self.site.url + self.site.skin.out_path(path), data, timeout=10) as response:
147	                text = response.read().decode()
148	            if 'type="password"' in text and path != "/login":
149	                self.sign_in()
150	            elif "vorübergehend nicht verfügbar" not in text:
151	                return text
152	        return text

154	    def sign_in(self) -> None:
155	        self.call("/login", {"username": self.site.user, "password": self.site.password, "next": "/"})
156	        self.call("/consent", {"wahl": "notwendig", "next": "/"})
157	        if self.entry:
158	            self.call(self.entry, {"bestaetigt": "1", "next": "/"})

161	def enter(app: sites.App, answer: dict) -> None:
162	    w = app.world
163	    base = f"/a/{w.tender.tid}/angebot"
164	    client = Client(app.sites["tender"], f"/a/{w.tender.tid}/teilnahme" if "interest" in app.skin.platform else "")
165	    client.sign_in()
166	    name = app.skin.field
167	    by_number = {p["position"]: p for p in answer["positions"]}
168	    values = {"firma": w.company, "ustid": w.vat, "email": w.mailbox, "anerkannt": "1",
169	              "art": "verzicht" if answer["decision"] == "no_bid" else "haupt",
170	              "rabatt": scenario.plain(answer["discount_percent"]), "summe": scenario.de(answer["total_net"])}
171	    for i, p in enumerate(w.tender.positions):
172	        row = by_number.get(p.number)
173	        if row is None:
174	            values[f"p{i}_auslassen"] = "1"
175	            continue
176	        values.update({f"p{i}_material": row["material_number"], f"p{i}_menge": str(row["quantity"]),
177	                       f"p{i}_preis": scenario.de(row["unit_price"]), f"p{i}_lieferzeit": str(row["lead_time_weeks"]),
178	                       f"p{i}_basis": scenario.de(row["base_unit_price"]),
179	                       f"p{i}_zuschlag": scenario.de(row["surcharge_per_unit"]),
180	                       f"p{i}_verpackung": scenario.de(row["packaging_per_unit"]),
181	                       f"p{i}_bonus": scenario.de(row["rebate_total"])})
182	    values = {name(k): v for k, v in values.items()}
183	    step = 1
184	    while True:
185	        page = client.call(f"{base}?schritt={step}")
186	        names = set(re.findall(r'name="([^"]+)"', page)) - {"aktion", "schritt"}
187	        form = {n: values[n] for n in names if n in values}
188	        page = client.call(base, {**form, "schritt": str(step), "aktion": "weiter"})
189	        if "TAN anfordern" in page or "kann noch nicht" in page:
190	            break

192	    client.call(base + "/pruefen", {"aktion": "tan"})
193	    client.call(base + "/pruefen", {"aktion": "abgeben", "tan": app.tans[w.tender.tid]["tan"]})

196	def cmd_check(args) -> int:
197	    bad, decisions = 0, collections.Counter()
198	    for seed in range(args.first, args.first + args.seeds):
199	        world = scenario.generate(seed, args.dataset)
200	        expected = oracle.solve(world)

221	    print(f"{args.seeds} scenarios ({dict(decisions)}), {min(args.forms, args.seeds)} form round trips: "

340	def usage(traces: Path, model: str) -> dict:
341	    """The tokens a run's trace reports and their cost at the simulated prices (None for a model without one).
342	    Every event that carries token counts is summed: finished workers, stopped ones and single extraction calls."""
343	    tokens = {"input_tokens": 0, "cached_tokens": 0, "output_tokens": 0}
344	    for path in traces.glob("run-*.jsonl"):
345	        for line in path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines():
346	            try:
347	                event = json.loads(line)
348	            except ValueError:
349	                continue  # a run killed mid-write leaves a partial last line
350	            for key in tokens:
351	                tokens[key] += event.get(key) or 0
352	    price = next((p for name, p in PRICES.items() if name in model.casefold()), None)
353	    cost = None
354	    if price:
355	        fresh = max(0, tokens["input_tokens"] - tokens["cached_tokens"])
356	        cost = round((fresh * price["input"] + tokens["cached_tokens"] * price["cached_input"]
357	                      + tokens["output_tokens"] * price["output"]) / 1_000_000, 4)
358	    return {**tokens, "model": model, "cost_usd": cost}

361	def run_agent(seed: int, args) -> dict:
362	    world = scenario.generate(seed, args.dataset)
363	    expected = oracle.solve(world)
364	    app = sites.App(world)
365	    sites.start(app)
366	    env = {k: v for k, v in os.environ.items() if k not in ("CHALLENGE_RUN_TOKEN", "CHALLENGE_API_URL")}
367	    traces = ROOT / "agent" / "traces" / f"synth-{seed}-{time.strftime('%Y%m%d-%H%M%S')}"
368	    traces.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
369	    env.update(CHALLENGE_SCOUTING=json.dumps(build_run(app, args.minutes * 60)), TRACE_DIR=str(traces),
370	               HEADLESS=env.get("HEADLESS", "1"), NO_PROXY="127.0.0.1,localhost", no_proxy="127.0.0.1,localhost")
371	    env.setdefault("QWEN_BASE_URL", "http://127.0.0.1:8765/qwen/v1")
372	    env.setdefault("QWEN_API_KEY", "local")
373	    started = time.time()
374	    with (traces / "agent.log").open("w") as log:
375	        try:
376	            code = subprocess.run(["uv", "run", "--no-sync", "python", "agent.py"], cwd=ROOT / "agent", env=env,
377	                                  stdout=log, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, timeout=args.minutes * 60 + 120).returncode
378	        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
379	            code = -1
380	    result = judge(app, expected)
381	    used = usage(traces, env.get("LLM_MODEL") or env.get("AGENT_MODEL") or "qwen")
382	    seconds = result.get("seconds") or round(time.time() - started, 1)  # no signed bid: the whole run counts
383	    used["cost_x_time"] = None if used["cost_usd"] is None else round(max(used["cost_usd"], 0.01) * max(seconds, 1), 2)
384	    commit = subprocess.run(["git", "rev-parse", "--short", "HEAD"], cwd=ROOT, capture_output=True, text=True).stdout

386	                                text=True).stdout.strip())

"""
Synthetic scenarios for the agent: generate, check, browse, and run the agent against them with a score.

Each seed is one invented tender on four local websites with their own look (see scenario.py and sites.py). The
expected answer comes from oracle.py, so a run gets the same breakdown a sandbox test run shows, for data and
layouts the agent has never seen. Nothing here is part of the package, and nothing here may flow back into
`agent/` as site knowledge: use a failing seed to find what is too specific in the agent, then fix that in general.

From the repo root (`uv run --project agent` gives the agent's Python and Playwright):
    uv run --project agent python dev/synth/run.py check --seeds 300      # oracle vs agent/calc.py, form round trip
    uv run --project agent python dev/synth/run.py show --seed 7          # features, look and expected answer
    uv run --project agent python dev/synth/run.py serve --seed 7         # browse the four sites yourself
    uv run --project agent python dev/synth/run.py agent --seeds 7,8,9    # needs `atira models proxy` running
    uv run --project agent python dev/synth/run.py export --seeds 0-19    # plain JSON for another environment
Results of `agent` go to experiments/synth-runs.jsonl (gitignored); `report` summarises them by dataset, feature
and look. Each run records what the platform ranks by: quality (the rule-29 scorer), time (start of the agent to
the signed bid) and cost (the trace's tokens at the simulated prices in prices.json), and cost x time with the
platform's floors. Time and cost are measured on this machine against local sites: they compare two versions of
the agent with each other, they do not predict a scored run's figures.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import collections
import json
import os
import random
import re
import subprocess
import sys
import time
import urllib.request
from http.cookiejar import CookieJar
from pathlib import Path
from urllib.parse import urlencode

HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
ROOT = HERE.parent.parent
sys.path.insert(0, str(HERE))

import oracle  # noqa: E402
import scenario  # noqa: E402
import sites  # noqa: E402

RESULTS = ROOT / "experiments" / "synth-runs.jsonl"
PRICES = json.loads((HERE / "prices.json").read_text())["usd_per_million_tokens"]
ROLE_TEXT = {
    "tender": "the tender portal: the tender, its bill of quantities{qa} and the bid form where the bid is entered "
              "and signed",
    "supplier": "the buyer's supplier portal: the technical specification and its revisions{qa}",
    "erp": "the company's ERP: materials with status, stock, lead times, price conditions, carton sizes and masses",
    "mail": "the bidder's webmail: the sales director's discount approval, the authority messages the rules name "
            "and the signing TAN",
}


def brief(app: sites.App) -> str:
    w, skin = app.world, app.skin
    access, rules, submission = skin.headings
    lines = []
    for role, site in app.sites.items():
        qa = ", the bidder Q&A (questions and answers)" if skin.qa_site == role else ""
        lines.append(f"- `{site.sid}` ({site.name}): {site.url} — {ROLE_TEXT[role].format(qa=qa)}")
    random.Random(w.seed).shuffle(lines)
    bid_site = app.sites["tender"]
    return f"""# Task brief

You work for {w.company}. Prepare, enter and sign exactly one bid on the public tender **{w.reference}**.

- Tender reference: `{w.reference}`
- Scenario date and time: {w.scenario.strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ')} (the websites run on this clock)
- Bidder: {w.company}, VAT id (USt-IdNr.) {w.vat}
- Sales director, the only person who approves order discounts: {w.director_name} <{w.director}>
- Bidder mailbox: the webmail account of this run. Authorised senders in the rules are a local part plus this
  mailbox's domain.

## {access}

The logins are in the run's access list.

{chr(10).join(lines)}

## {rules}

{(HERE / 'rules.md').read_text(encoding='utf-8').strip()}

## {submission}

Enter the bid in the bid form of `{bid_site.sid}` for tender {w.reference}. Register with the company name and VAT
id above and the bidder mailbox address as contact email. Choose the main offer, or the no-bid declaration when the
decision is no_bid; never an alternative offer. Enter each position with its material number, final quantity in
pieces, net unit price, lead time in weeks and the four breakdown fields, or mark the position as omitted. Enter the
discount percentage and the net total. Acknowledge the tender documents; do not declare your own terms and
conditions. Then request the signing TAN, read it in the webmail and submit the bid with it. A saved bid that is not
signed does not count.
"""


def build_run(app: sites.App, seconds: int = 20 * 60) -> dict:
    access = [{"siteId": s.sid, "url": s.url, "credentials": {"username": s.user, "password": s.password}}
              for s in app.sites.values()]
    random.Random(app.world.seed + 3).shuffle(access)
    bid_site = app.sites["tender"]
    now = int(time.time() * 1000)
    return {"run_id": None, "brief": brief(app), "access": access,
            "submission": {"kind": "site", "siteId": bid_site.sid, "url": bid_site.url},
            "answer_schema": json.loads((HERE / "answer_schema.json").read_text()), "started_at": now,
            "expires_at": now + seconds * 1000}


def judge(app: sites.App, expected: dict) -> dict:
    """The score of the signed bid, with the form's own traps counted (an alternative offer is not a bid)."""
    signed = app.signed
    answer = signed and dict(signed["answer"])
    if answer and signed["meta"]["offer_type"] == "neben":
        answer["decision"] = "alternative_offer"
    result = oracle.score(app.world, expected, answer)
    if signed:
        w = app.world
        meta = signed["meta"]
        result["form"] = {"own_terms_declared": meta["own_terms"], "omitted": meta["omitted"],
                          "extra_rows": meta["extra_rows"], "tan_requests": meta["tan_requests"],
                          "discards": meta["discards"],
                          "company_ok": meta["company"] == w.company and meta["vat"] == w.vat,
                          "contact_ok": meta["email"].casefold() == w.mailbox.casefold()}
        result["seconds"] = meta["seconds"]
    return result


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- a scripted client, to test the sites themselves


class Client:
    """Fills the bid form over plain HTTP with a given answer: proves a scenario's form and scoring work.
    It knows the form's field names, so it says nothing about the agent."""

    def __init__(self, site: sites.Site, entry: str = ""):
        self.site, self.entry = site, entry  # entry: the address of a tender's entry step, when it has one
        self.opener = urllib.request.build_opener(urllib.request.HTTPCookieProcessor(CookieJar()))

    def call(self, path: str, form: dict | None = None) -> str:
        """A page by the address and field names of the sites' code, whatever this seed's sites call them. A
        temporary error is asked again; a session that ended is signed in again."""
        data = urlencode(form).encode() if form is not None else None
        for _ in range(4):
            with self.opener.open(self.site.url + self.site.skin.out_path(path), data, timeout=10) as response:
                text = response.read().decode()
            if 'type="password"' in text and path != "/login":
                self.sign_in()
            elif "vorübergehend nicht verfügbar" not in text:
                return text
        return text

    def sign_in(self) -> None:
        self.call("/login", {"username": self.site.user, "password": self.site.password, "next": "/"})
        self.call("/consent", {"wahl": "notwendig", "next": "/"})
        if self.entry:
            self.call(self.entry, {"bestaetigt": "1", "next": "/"})


def enter(app: sites.App, answer: dict) -> None:
    w = app.world
    base = f"/a/{w.tender.tid}/angebot"
    client = Client(app.sites["tender"], f"/a/{w.tender.tid}/teilnahme" if "interest" in app.skin.platform else "")
    client.sign_in()
    name = app.skin.field
    by_number = {p["position"]: p for p in answer["positions"]}
    values = {"firma": w.company, "ustid": w.vat, "email": w.mailbox, "anerkannt": "1",
              "art": "verzicht" if answer["decision"] == "no_bid" else "haupt",
              "rabatt": scenario.plain(answer["discount_percent"]), "summe": scenario.de(answer["total_net"])}
    for i, p in enumerate(w.tender.positions):
        row = by_number.get(p.number)
        if row is None:
            values[f"p{i}_auslassen"] = "1"
            continue
        values.update({f"p{i}_material": row["material_number"], f"p{i}_menge": str(row["quantity"]),
                       f"p{i}_preis": scenario.de(row["unit_price"]), f"p{i}_lieferzeit": str(row["lead_time_weeks"]),
                       f"p{i}_basis": scenario.de(row["base_unit_price"]),
                       f"p{i}_zuschlag": scenario.de(row["surcharge_per_unit"]),
                       f"p{i}_verpackung": scenario.de(row["packaging_per_unit"]),
                       f"p{i}_bonus": scenario.de(row["rebate_total"])})
    values = {name(k): v for k, v in values.items()}
    step = 1
    while True:
        page = client.call(f"{base}?schritt={step}")
        names = set(re.findall(r'name="([^"]+)"', page)) - {"aktion", "schritt"}
        form = {n: values[n] for n in names if n in values}
        page = client.call(base, {**form, "schritt": str(step), "aktion": "weiter"})
        if "TAN anfordern" in page or "kann noch nicht" in page:
            break
        step += 1
    client.call(base + "/pruefen", {"aktion": "tan"})
    client.call(base + "/pruefen", {"aktion": "abgeben", "tan": app.tans[w.tender.tid]["tan"]})


def cmd_check(args) -> int:
    bad, decisions = 0, collections.Counter()
    for seed in range(args.first, args.first + args.seeds):
        world = scenario.generate(seed, args.dataset)
        expected = oracle.solve(world)
        decisions[expected["decision"]] += 1
        problems = []
        if oracle.via_calc(world) != expected:
            problems.append("agent/calc.py disagrees with the oracle")
        if seed < args.first + args.forms:
            app = sites.App(world)
            servers = sites.start(app)
            try:
                enter(app, expected)
                result = judge(app, expected)
                if result["quality"] != 100 or not result["eligible"]:
                    problems.append(f"form round trip scored {result['quality']}: {result['wrong'][:3]}")
            except Exception as error:
                problems.append(f"form round trip failed: {error!r}")
            finally:
                for server in servers:
                    server.shutdown()
        if problems:
            bad += 1
            print(f"seed {seed}: {'; '.join(problems)}")
    print(f"{args.seeds} scenarios ({dict(decisions)}), {min(args.forms, args.seeds)} form round trips: "
          f"{bad or 'no'} problem(s)")
    return 1 if bad else 0


def cmd_show(args) -> int:
    world = scenario.generate(args.seed, args.dataset)
    app = sites.App(world)
    print(json.dumps({"seed": args.seed, "features": world.features, "look": app.skin.describe(),
                      "expected": oracle.solve(world, detail=True)}, indent=1, ensure_ascii=False, default=str))
    return 0


def cmd_serve(args) -> int:
    app = sites.App(scenario.generate(args.seed, args.dataset))
    sites.start(app, args.port)
    run = build_run(app, 24 * 3600)
    for site in run["access"]:
        print(f"{site['siteId']:16} {site['url']}  {site['credentials']['username']} / "
              f"{site['credentials']['password']}")
    path = HERE / f".run-{args.seed}.json"
    path.write_text(json.dumps(run))
    print(f"\nThe run (brief, logins) is in {path}. To point the agent at it:\n"
          f"  export CHALLENGE_SCOUTING=\"$(cat {path})\"\nCtrl-C stops the sites.")
    try:
        while app.signed is None:
            time.sleep(1)
        print(json.dumps(judge(app, oracle.solve(app.world)), indent=1, ensure_ascii=False))
    except KeyboardInterrupt:
        pass
    return 0


def export(seed: int, dataset: str = "mixed") -> dict:
    """One scenario as plain data, to load into another environment: what each website shows, the brief, and
    (under "labels" and "expected") what the records mean and the one correct answer, which the sites never show."""
    world = scenario.generate(seed, dataset)
    app = sites.App(world)
    for role, site in app.sites.items():
        site.url = "{{" + role.upper() + "_URL}}"

    def iso(value):
        return value.strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ") if hasattr(value, "hour") else value.isoformat()

    def plain(value):
        if isinstance(value, dict):
            return {k: plain(v) for k, v in value.items()}
        if isinstance(value, (list, tuple)):
            return [plain(v) for v in value]
        if hasattr(value, "isoformat"):
            return iso(value)
        return value if isinstance(value, (str, int, float, bool, type(None))) else str(value)

    def tender(t) -> dict:
        return {"id": t.tid, "reference": t.reference, "title": t.title, "buyer": t.buyer,
                "positions": [{"position": p.number, "short_text": p.text, "quantity": p.quantity, "unit": p.unit,
                               "requirement": p.requirement} for p in t.positions]}

    def requirement(q) -> dict:
        return {"id": q.rid, "bore_mm": q.bore, "stroke_mm": str(q.stroke), "stroke_is_usable_travel": q.usable,
                "end_reserve_key": q.reserve_key, "pressure_bar": q.pressure, "mounting": q.mounting,
                "certification": q.certification, "catalog_group": q.group, "pieces_per_set": q.pieces_per_set}

    return {
        "generation": scenario.GENERATION, "dataset": dataset, "seed": seed, "features": plain(world.features),
        "scenario": {"tender_reference": world.reference, "scenario_date": iso(world.scenario),
                     "company": world.company, "vat_id": world.vat, "bidder_mailbox": world.mailbox,
                     "mailbox_domain": world.domain, "director": {"name": world.director_name,
                                                                  "address": world.director},
                     "authorised_senders": world.senders()},
        "sites": {role: {"site_id": site.sid, "name": site.name, "url_placeholder": site.url}
                  for role, site in app.sites.items()},
        "brief": brief(app),
        "tender_portal": {
            "tender": tender(world.tender), "other_tenders": [tender(t) for t in world.decoys],
            "qa": [{"number": q.number, "date": iso(q.date), "question": q.question, "answer": q.answer,
                    "labels": {"kind": q.kind, **plain(q.data)}} for q in world.qa]},
        "supplier_portal": {"specification": {
            "title": world.spec_title,
            "revisions": [{"id": r.name, "date": iso(r.date), "status": r.status,
                           "requirements": [requirement(q) for q in r.reqs.values()]} for r in world.revisions]}},
        "erp": {"materials": [{
            "material_number": m.number, "description": m.text, "catalog_group": m.group, "status": m.status,
            "bore_mm": m.bore, "stroke_mm": str(m.stroke), "pressure_bar": m.pressure, "mounting": m.mounting,
            "certification": m.certification, "free_stock": m.free_stock, "blocked_stock": m.blocked_stock,
            "lead_time_stock_weeks": m.lt_stock, "lead_time_production_weeks": m.lt_prod,
            "pieces_per_carton": m.carton, "allocation_mass_kg": str(m.alloc_mass),
            "surcharge_mass_kg": str(m.sur_mass), "metal_index": m.index_code,
            "price_conditions": [{"valid_from": iso(c.valid_from), "valid_to": iso(c.valid_to),
                                  "currency": c.currency, "fx_key": c.fx_key, "price_unit": c.price_unit,
                                  "scales": [{"min_quantity": a, "price": str(b)} for a, b in c.scales]}
                                 for c in m.conditions]} for m in world.materials]},
        "webmail": {"mailbox": world.mailbox, "messages": [{
            "id": m.mid, "folder": m.folder, "from_name": m.sender_name, "from": m.sender, "date": iso(m.date),
            "subject": m.subject, "body": m.body,
            "labels": {"kind": m.kind, "reference": m.reference, "is_record": m.is_record, **plain(m.data)}}
            for m in sorted(world.mails, key=lambda m: m.date)]},
        "expected": oracle.solve(world, detail=True),
    }


def cmd_export(args) -> int:
    folder = args.out / args.dataset
    folder.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    manifest = []
    for seed in args.seeds:
        data = export(seed, args.dataset)
        name = f"{data['features'].get('trap') or 'scenario'}-{seed:04d}.json"
        (folder / name).write_text(json.dumps(data, ensure_ascii=False, indent=1), encoding="utf-8")
        manifest.append({"file": name, "seed": seed, "tender_reference": data["scenario"]["tender_reference"],
                         "decision": data["expected"]["decision"], "positions": len(
                             data["tender_portal"]["tender"]["positions"]), "features": data["features"]})
    (folder / "manifest.json").write_text(json.dumps({
        "dataset": args.dataset, "what": scenario.DATASETS[args.dataset], "generation": scenario.GENERATION,
        "scenarios": manifest}, ensure_ascii=False, indent=1), encoding="utf-8")
    print(f"{args.dataset}: {len(args.seeds)} scenarios written to {folder}")
    return 0


def usage(traces: Path, model: str) -> dict:
    """The tokens a run's trace reports and their cost at the simulated prices (None for a model without one).
    Every event that carries token counts is summed: finished workers, stopped ones and single extraction calls."""
    tokens = {"input_tokens": 0, "cached_tokens": 0, "output_tokens": 0}
    for path in traces.glob("run-*.jsonl"):
        for line in path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines():
            try:
                event = json.loads(line)
            except ValueError:
                continue  # a run killed mid-write leaves a partial last line
            for key in tokens:
                tokens[key] += event.get(key) or 0
    price = next((p for name, p in PRICES.items() if name in model.casefold()), None)
    cost = None
    if price:
        fresh = max(0, tokens["input_tokens"] - tokens["cached_tokens"])
        cost = round((fresh * price["input"] + tokens["cached_tokens"] * price["cached_input"]
                      + tokens["output_tokens"] * price["output"]) / 1_000_000, 4)
    return {**tokens, "model": model, "cost_usd": cost}


def run_agent(seed: int, args) -> dict:
    world = scenario.generate(seed, args.dataset)
    expected = oracle.solve(world)
    app = sites.App(world)
    sites.start(app)
    env = {k: v for k, v in os.environ.items() if k not in ("CHALLENGE_RUN_TOKEN", "CHALLENGE_API_URL")}
    traces = ROOT / "agent" / "traces" / f"synth-{seed}-{time.strftime('%Y%m%d-%H%M%S')}"
    traces.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    env.update(CHALLENGE_SCOUTING=json.dumps(build_run(app, args.minutes * 60)), TRACE_DIR=str(traces),
               HEADLESS=env.get("HEADLESS", "1"), NO_PROXY="127.0.0.1,localhost", no_proxy="127.0.0.1,localhost")
    env.setdefault("QWEN_BASE_URL", "http://127.0.0.1:8765/qwen/v1")
    env.setdefault("QWEN_API_KEY", "local")
    started = time.time()
    with (traces / "agent.log").open("w") as log:
        try:
            code = subprocess.run(["uv", "run", "--no-sync", "python", "agent.py"], cwd=ROOT / "agent", env=env,
                                  stdout=log, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, timeout=args.minutes * 60 + 120).returncode
        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
            code = -1
    result = judge(app, expected)
    used = usage(traces, env.get("LLM_MODEL") or env.get("AGENT_MODEL") or "qwen")
    seconds = result.get("seconds") or round(time.time() - started, 1)  # no signed bid: the whole run counts
    used["cost_x_time"] = None if used["cost_usd"] is None else round(max(used["cost_usd"], 0.01) * max(seconds, 1), 2)
    commit = subprocess.run(["git", "rev-parse", "--short", "HEAD"], cwd=ROOT, capture_output=True, text=True).stdout
    dirty = bool(subprocess.run(["git", "status", "--porcelain", "--", "agent"], cwd=ROOT, capture_output=True,
                                text=True).stdout.strip())
    record = {"at": time.strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S"), "seed": seed, "generation": scenario.GENERATION, "version": args.version, "note": args.note,
              "commit": commit.strip(), "dirty": dirty, "quality": result["quality"], "eligible": result["eligible"],
              "decision": expected["decision"], "seconds": result.get("seconds"), "wall": round(time.time() - started),
              "exit": code, "parts": result["parts"], "wrong": result["wrong"], "form": result.get("form"),
              "dataset": args.dataset, **used,
              "features": world.features, "look": app.skin.describe(), "requests": app.hits, "traces": str(traces),
              "env": {k: v for k, v in os.environ.items() if re.match(r"AGENT_|LLM_|THINKING|MAX_STEPS|SPEC_", k)}}
    RESULTS.parent.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    with RESULTS.open("a") as out:
        out.write(json.dumps(record, ensure_ascii=False, default=str) + "\n")
    return record


def cmd_agent(args) -> int:
    try:
        urllib.request.urlopen(os.environ.get("QWEN_BASE_URL", "http://127.0.0.1:8765/").split("/qwen")[0], timeout=5)
    except urllib.error.HTTPError:
        pass  # the proxy answers, whatever the status
    except OSError:
        print("No model endpoint: start `atira models proxy` in another terminal (or set QWEN_BASE_URL/QWEN_API_KEY).")
        return 1
    for seed in args.seeds:
        record = run_agent(seed, args)
        cost = "-" if record["cost_usd"] is None else f"${record['cost_usd']:.4f}"
        print(f"seed {seed}: quality {record['quality']} eligible {record['eligible']} "
              f"({record['decision']} case) in {record['seconds'] or '-'} s, cost {cost}, cost x time "
              f"{record['cost_x_time'] or '-'}; wrong: {record['wrong'][:8]}", flush=True)
    return 0


def cmd_report(args) -> int:
    if not RESULTS.exists():
        print("No synthetic runs recorded yet.")
        return 0
    runs = [json.loads(line) for line in RESULTS.read_text().splitlines() if line.strip()]
    if args.version:
        runs = [r for r in runs if r.get("version") == args.version]
    if args.dataset:
        runs = [r for r in runs if r.get("dataset") == args.dataset]
    print(summary(runs))
    by: dict[str, list[float]] = collections.defaultdict(list)
    sets: dict[str, list[dict]] = collections.defaultdict(list)
    for r in runs:
        sets[r.get("dataset") or r["features"].get("dataset", "?")].append(r)
        for source in ("features", "look"):
            for key, value in r[source].items():
                if isinstance(value, (bool, str)):
                    by[f"{source}.{key}={value}"].append(r["quality"])
        for key, every in (("hazards", ("flaky", "timeout", "modal", "inject", "gate")), ("platform", sites.PLATFORM)):
            if key in r["look"]:  # a run with and without each nuisance and each platform hazard
                for hazard in every:
                    by[f"look.{key}.{hazard}={hazard in r['look'][key]}"].append(r["quality"])
    for name, group in sorted(sets.items()):
        print(f"  {name:22} {summary(group)}")
    for key, scores in sorted(by.items(), key=lambda kv: sum(kv[1]) / len(kv[1])):
        print(f"  {sum(scores) / len(scores):6.1f}  n={len(scores):<3} {key}")
    misses = collections.Counter(re.sub(r"position \S+: ", "position: ", w) for r in runs for w in r["wrong"])
    print("most often wrong:", misses.most_common(10))
    return 0


def summary(runs: list[dict]) -> str:
    """Quality, time and cost of a set of runs in one line, as the platform ranks: quality, then cost x time."""
    def mean(key: str) -> str:
        values = [r[key] for r in runs if r.get(key) is not None]
        return f"{sum(values) / len(values):.4g}" if values else "-"

    return (f"{len(runs)} runs, mean quality {sum(r['quality'] for r in runs) / max(1, len(runs)):.1f}, "
            f"{sum(r['quality'] == 100 for r in runs)} at 100, {sum(not r['eligible'] for r in runs)} not eligible, "
            f"mean {mean('seconds')} s, ${mean('cost_usd')}, cost x time {mean('cost_x_time')}")


def seed_list(text: str) -> list[int]:
    seeds: list[int] = []
    for part in text.split(","):
        first, _, last = part.partition("-")
        seeds += range(int(first), int(last or first) + 1)
    return seeds


def main() -> int:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__.split("\n\n")[0])
    commands = parser.add_subparsers(dest="command", required=True)
    check = commands.add_parser("check")
    check.add_argument("--seeds", type=int, default=300)
    check.add_argument("--first", type=int, default=0)
    check.add_argument("--forms", type=int, default=60, help="how many of the seeds also get a form round trip")
    show = commands.add_parser("show")
    show.add_argument("--seed", type=int, required=True)
    serve = commands.add_parser("serve")
    serve.add_argument("--seed", type=int, required=True)
    serve.add_argument("--port", type=int, default=8800)
    agent = commands.add_parser("agent")
    agent.add_argument("--seeds", type=seed_list, required=True, help="e.g. 0-5 or 3,7,12")
    agent.add_argument("--minutes", type=int, default=20)
    agent.add_argument("--version", default="")
    agent.add_argument("--note", default="")
    out = commands.add_parser("export")
    out.add_argument("--seeds", type=seed_list, required=True, help="e.g. 0-19 or 3,7,12")
    out.add_argument("--out", type=Path, default=HERE / "data")
    report = commands.add_parser("report")
    report.add_argument("--version", default="")
    report.add_argument("--dataset", default="", choices=["", *scenario.DATASETS])
    for command in (check, show, serve, agent, out):
        command.add_argument("--dataset", default="mixed", choices=list(scenario.DATASETS))
    args = parser.parse_args()
    return {"check": cmd_check, "show": cmd_show, "serve": cmd_serve, "agent": cmd_agent, "export": cmd_export,
            "report": cmd_report}[args.command](args)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

""" One synthetic scenario as a platform eval (docs/evals.md): the four mock sites on the platform's ports, signing in with the logins the platform hands each run, and the signed bid handed to the platform, which scores it. `run.py bundle` copies this file into an eval folder as `server.py`, beside scenario.py, sites.py, oracle.py, `eval.json` (seed and dataset), BRIEF.md and expected.json. The platform starts it with PORT_ per site, ATIRA_API_URL and ATIRA_EVAL_TOKEN; `atira eval dev` does the same here with a local stand-in. One process serves every run of the eval, so each run (and each preview) gets its own `sites.App`: its own drafts, sessions, TANs and scenario clock, started at its first sign-in. The sites' code is unchanged. python3 server.py --check # the build step: the scenario generated here gives the bundled expected.json python3 server.py # serve """ from __future__ import annotations import json import os import re import sys import threading import time import urllib.error import urllib.request from http.cookies import SimpleCookie from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler, ThreadingHTTPServer from pathlib import Path from urllib.parse import parse_qs, unquote, urlparse HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent sys.path.insert(0, str(HERE)) import oracle # noqa: E402 import scenario # noqa: E402 import sites # noqa: E402 RECHECK = 10 # seconds a login is trusted before the platform is asked again: a run that ended is signed out KEEP = 3600 # seconds a run's state is kept after its login expired esc = sites.esc def variable(name: str) -> str: """A site's name as the platform writes it in variable names: my-site -> MY_SITE.""" return re.sub(r"[^A-Z0-9]", "_", name.upper()) def platform(path: str, payload: dict) -> tuple[int, dict]: """POST JSON to the platform with the eval's token: (status, body); status 0 when it does not answer.""" request = urllib.request.Request( os.environ.get("ATIRA_API_URL", "").rstrip("/") + path, json.dumps(payload).encode(), method="POST", headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {os.environ.get('ATIRA_EVAL_TOKEN', '')}", "Content-Type": "application/json", "User-Agent": "synth-eval/1"}) try: with urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=20) as response: status, raw = response.status, response.read() except urllib.error.HTTPError as error: status, raw = error.code, error.read() except (OSError, ValueError): return 0, {} try: body = json.loads(raw or b"{}") except ValueError: body = {} return status, body if isinstance(body, dict) else {} def outgoing(signed: dict, expected: dict) -> dict: """The signed bid as the platform's answer. An alternative offer is not a bid: where a bid was due it goes out as the other decision, so the form's trap costs what it costs in `run.judge`.""" answer = dict(signed["answer"]) if signed["meta"]["offer_type"] == "neben" and expected["decision"] == "bid": answer.update(decision="no_bid", positions=[], total_net=0.0) return answer class Login: """A signed-in browser: the run or preview it belongs to and the login to ask the platform about again.""" def __init__(self, app: sites.App, kind: str, ident: str, username: str, password: str): self.app, self.kind, self.ident, self.username, self.password = app, kind, ident, username, password self.checked = time.time() class Eval: def __init__(self, folder: Path = HERE): config = json.loads((folder / "eval.json").read_text()) self.expected = json.loads((folder / "expected.json").read_text()) self.manifest = json.loads((folder / "atira-eval.json").read_text()) self.world = scenario.generate(config["seed"], config["dataset"]) self.front = sites.App(self.world) # serves what needs no login: the sign-in page and the way to it self.names = {site.sid: role for role, site in self.front.sites.items()} self.apps: dict[str, sites.App] = {} self.logins: dict[tuple[str, str], Login] = {} # (role, cookie) -> login self.lock = threading.Lock() def problems(self) -> list[str]: """What keeps this process from being the eval the bundle describes.""" found = [] if json.loads(json.dumps(oracle.solve(self.world))) != self.expected: found.append("the scenario generated here does not give the bundled expected.json: bundle it again " "with this Python version") if sorted(self.names) != sorted(site["name"] for site in self.manifest["sites"]): found.append("the sites generated here are not the ones in atira-eval.json") return found def app(self, key: str, expires_at: float) -> sites.App: """The run's own sites, made at its first sign-in.""" with self.lock: now = time.time() for old in [k for k, a in self.apps.items() if a.expires_at + KEEP < now]: del self.apps[old] self.logins = {k: v for k, v in self.logins.items() if v.app is not self.apps.get(old)} if key not in self.apps: app = sites.App(self.world) app.handed_in = False app.hand_in = threading.Lock() self.apps[key] = app self.apps[key].expires_at = expires_at return self.apps[key] # ---- a request def answer(self, name: str, method: str, path: str, q: dict, form: dict, cookie: str | None ) -> tuple[sites.Resp, str | None]: role = self.names[name] front = self.front.sites[role] if path == "/login" and method == "POST": status, body = platform("/v1/eval-worlds/verify", { "site": name, "username": form.get("username", ""), "password": form.get("password", "")}) kind = "run" if body.get("run_id") else "preview" if body.get("preview_id") else "" if status != 200 or not kind: note = ("Benutzername oder Passwort ist falsch." if status in (200, 401, 403) else "Die Anmeldung ist gerade nicht möglich. Bitte erneut versuchen.") return sites.Resp(front.login(form.get("next", ""), note), 401 if status in (200, 401, 403) else 503), None ident = str(body.get("run_id") or body.get("preview_id")) expires = float(body.get("expires_at") or 0) / 1000 app = self.app(f"{kind}:{ident}", expires if expires > time.time() else time.time() + 3600) site = app.sites[role] site.user, site.password = form["username"], form["password"] resp, new = site.dispatch(method, path, q, form, cookie) if new: self.logins[(role, new)] = Login(app, kind, ident, form["username"], form["password"]) return resp, new login = self.logins.get((role, cookie or "")) if login and time.time() - login.checked > RECHECK: status, _ = platform("/v1/eval-worlds/verify", { "site": name, "username": login.username, "password": login.password}) if status in (401, 403): # the run ended self.logins.pop((role, cookie), None) login.app.sites[role].sessions.pop(cookie, None) login = None elif status == 200: # busy or away: the session stays and is asked about on the next request login.checked = time.time() if login is None: return front.dispatch(method, path, q, form, None) resp, new = login.app.sites[role].dispatch(method, path, q, form, cookie) if role == "tender": resp = self.hand_in(login, resp) return resp, new def hand_in(self, login: Login, resp: sites.Resp) -> sites.Resp: """Hand a freshly signed bid to the platform; the page says so when the platform does not take it.""" app, site = login.app, login.app.sites["tender"] with app.hand_in: signed = app.signed if signed is None or app.handed_in: return resp status, body = platform("/v1/eval-worlds/answer", { "run_id" if login.kind == "run" else "preview_id": login.ident, "bid": outgoing(signed, self.expected)}) print(f"[answer] {login.kind} {login.ident}: HTTP {status} {json.dumps(signed['meta'])}", flush=True) if status in (200, 202): if login.kind == "run": app.handed_in = True return resp app.signed = None # a preview may sign again return site.page("Angebot abgegeben", f'

Ihr Angebot ist eingegangen. Beleg-Nr. ' f'{esc(signed["receipt"])}.

Bewertung der Vorschau

'
                                 f'{esc(json.dumps(body.get("score"), indent=1, ensure_ascii=False))}
') if status == 400: # the bid fails the answer schema: it is not signed, the form can be corrected app.signed = None issues = "".join(f"
  • {esc(str(i.get('path', '')))}: {esc(str(i.get('message', '')))}
    • " for i in body.get("issues", []) if isinstance(i, dict)) return site.page("Angebot nicht angenommen", f'
    Das Angebot wurde nicht angenommen. ' f'Bitte korrigieren Sie die Angaben und signieren Sie erneut:

"""
The synthetic sites as a platform eval (evalapp.py), against a stand-in for the platform's two endpoints: the
platform's logins sign in, each run has its own state, and the signed bid reaches the platform as the expected
answer. No browser and no model. From the repo root: python3 -m unittest discover -s dev/synth/tests
"""
import json
import os
import sys
import tempfile
import threading
import time
import unittest
import urllib.error
from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler, ThreadingHTTPServer
from pathlib import Path
from unittest import mock

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]))

import evalapp  # noqa: E402
import run  # noqa: E402

LOGINS = {"u_one": ("run_id", "run_1"), "u_two": ("run_id", "run_2"), "p_look": ("preview_id", "prev_1")}


class Platform(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    """The platform's verify and answer endpoints; what it was sent is kept on the server."""

    def log_message(self, *args) -> None:
        pass

    def do_POST(self) -> None:
        payload = json.loads(self.rfile.read(int(self.headers["Content-Length"])))
        state = self.server.state  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
        status, body = 401, {}
        if self.headers.get("Authorization") != "Bearer secret":
            pass
        elif self.path == "/v1/eval-worlds/verify":
            known = LOGINS.get(payload["username"])
            if known and payload["password"] == "pw" and payload["username"] not in state["ended"]:
                status, body = 200, {known[0]: known[1], "expires_at": int((time.time() + 1200) * 1000)}
        elif self.path == "/v1/eval-worlds/answer":
            state["answers"].append(payload)
            if state["issues"]:
                status, body = 400, {"issues": state["issues"]}
            elif "run_id" in payload:
                status, body = 202, {"accepted": True}
            else:
                status, body = 200, {"accepted": True, "score": {"quality": 100, "eligible": True}}
        raw = json.dumps(body).encode()
        self.send_response(status)
        self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(raw)))
        self.end_headers()
        self.wfile.write(raw)


class EvalApp(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.folder = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        folder = run.bundle(3, "platform-hazards", Path(self.folder.name))
        self.platform = ThreadingHTTPServer(("127.0.0.1", 0), Platform)
        self.platform.state = {"answers": [], "issues": [], "ended": set()}
        threading.Thread(target=self.platform.serve_forever, args=(0.02,), daemon=True).start()
        self.eval = evalapp.Eval(folder)
        names = [site["name"] for site in self.eval.manifest["sites"]]
        env = {"ATIRA_API_URL": f"http://127.0.0.1:{self.platform.server_address[1]}", "ATIRA_EVAL_TOKEN": "secret",
               **{f"PORT_{evalapp.variable(name)}": "0" for name in names}}
        patch = mock.patch.dict(os.environ, env)
        patch.start()
        self.addCleanup(patch.stop)
        self.servers = evalapp.start(self.eval, "127.0.0.1")
        self.urls = {server.name: f"http://127.0.0.1:{server.server_address[1]}" for server in self.servers}

    def tearDown(self):
        for server in [*self.servers, self.platform]:
            server.shutdown()
            server.server_close()
        self.folder.cleanup()

    def run_app(self, key: str, username: str):
        """A run's own sites, addressed and signed in the way the platform's login does it."""
        app = self.eval.app(key, time.time() + 1200)
        for site in app.sites.values():
            site.url, site.user, site.password = self.urls[site.sid], username, "pw"
        return app

    def test_the_bundle_matches_what_is_generated_here(self):
        self.assertEqual(self.eval.problems(), [])
        self.eval.expected["total_net"] += 1
        self.assertEqual(len(self.eval.problems()), 1)

    def test_a_signed_bid_reaches_the_platform_as_the_expected_answer(self):
        run.enter(self.run_app("run:run_1", "u_one"), self.eval.expected)
        self.assertEqual(self.platform.state["answers"], [{"run_id": "run_1", "bid": self.eval.expected}])

from pathlib import Path
p = Path("dev/synth/README.md"); s = p.read_text()
old = "## What a run measures\n"
new = '''## As a platform eval

`run.py bundle` writes one scenario as an eval folder for the platform (`docs/evals.md`): the sites' code with
`evalapp.py` as its server, the brief without addresses, and the oracle's answer as `expected.json`. The platform
hosts it and runs any of our packages on it in the sandbox, so a seed can be tried with a past submission too.

```sh
uv run --project agent python dev/synth/run.py bundle --dataset platform-hazards --seeds 0   # dev/synth/evals/<dataset>-<seed>
atira eval dev dev/synth/evals/platform-hazards-0        # here, with the platform's stand-in; prints each answer's score
atira eval deploy dev/synth/evals/platform-hazards-0 --slug err404-synth-hazards-0 --no-preview   # private
atira eval run err404-synth-hazards-0 --package ./agent --repeats 3    # or --package submission, sub_..., run_...
atira eval runs err404-synth-hazards-0
```

- One eval is one seed, and a team has 10 evals: local runs give the breadth, the platform the sandbox and old
  packages. `dev/synth/evals/` is gitignored; a folder's `.atira/eval.json` remembers its eval, so bundle and deploy
  again to push a new version after the generator or the sites changed.
- The build step (`server.py --check`) generates the scenario on the platform's Python and fails unless it gives the
  bundled `expected.json`.
- One process serves every run, so `evalapp.py` gives each run its own `sites.App` (drafts, sessions, TANs, clock)
  at its first sign-in. Logins are the platform's, checked again every 10 s.
- The platform scores with its eval weights (reference 5, discount 5, total 15, positions 75; per position material
  35 %, quantity 20 %, unit price 30 %, lead time 15 %). The four breakdown fields are sent but not scored there:
  for those, run the seed locally. An alternative offer where a bid was due is handed in as the other decision.
- Keep these evals private: a public eval's source and `expected.json` are open to every team.

## What a run measures
'''
assert old in s; p.write_text(s.replace(old, new, 1))
EOF

        self.assertEqual(away.exception.code, 503)

Not ready yet — the adapter works locally, but the first live run exposed a bug and I'm waiting on the run that confirms the fix.

- **Built:** `dev/synth/evalapp.py` serves any synth scenario as a platform eval, and `run.py bundle` writes the eval folder. It's on a new branch `synth-evals` in a separate worktree (`error404ai_ehl_finals-evals`), uncommitted.
- **Verified locally:** 22 tests pass, and entering the expected bid through `atira eval dev` scored 100 on the platform's stand-in.
- **Deployed:** one private eval, `err404-synth-hazards-0` (the `platform-hazards` dataset, seed 0). The platform's build generates the same scenario as the bundled expected answer.
- **Bug found live:** in the first run the agent looped on the login pages of the mail and spec sites from about 2:20 onward. My best explanation is that the adapter asked the platform to verify each tab's login separately and got rate-limited; I couldn't see the eval server's own log to confirm that.
- **Fix:** login checks are now shared per run and site (one platform call per 10 s), and a login the platform already accepted stays valid while it is busy. Redeployed; a second run of the current submission is in progress.

I'll report the result when that run finishes. Two things I noticed along the way:

- Your team already has three evals from teammates (`err404-traps`, `err404-nobid`, `err404-layout`), and the current submission scored 36.3, 0 and 5 on them. That's a strong sign the 100 on public-1 doesn't carry over.
- You're now using 5 of 10 eval slots, and I've used 2 of the shared 12 eval runs per hour.

content.content:
"""
Quick decisions with Cloudflare Clef, the hosted decision model, beside Qwen.

Clef answers fixed-form questions about a state in about a second: `choice` picks one of our options, `noul` gives the
probability of yes. Off unless AGENT_CLEF=1 (or USE_CLEF=1), so runs with and without it compare side by side; ship
it on only with "clef" in agent.json "models". Every helper returns None when Clef fails, and the caller goes on
without it.

Measured on hand-labelled page views (dev/clef_eval/RESULTS.md): Clef loses to Qwen without thinking at picking a
link and at judging whether a record is the right one (ordering, look-alike references, numbers), but it is exact and
fast at "is this an error, empty, locked or decoy page after my action", where Qwen without thinking slips. So the
only agent use is that check: the `page_check` tool, and `outcome_hint` for a hook after actions.
"""
import asyncio
import os
import re
import time

import httpx2 as httpx
from pydantic_ai import RunContext

TIMEOUT = float(os.environ.get("CLEF_TIMEOUT", "20"))
MAX_STATE = 12000  # characters of page text sent; Clef reads text far shorter than Qwen's context
_limit = asyncio.Semaphore(int(os.environ.get("CLEF_CONCURRENCY", "12")))  # team limit is 16 at once
USAGE = {"calls": 0, "input_tokens": 0, "seconds": 0.0}  # this process's Clef use, for the trace and cost
ELEMENT = re.compile(r"\[(e\d+) (link|button|summary|tab|menuitem)\b([^\]]*)\]")


def enabled() -> bool:
    on = os.environ.get("AGENT_CLEF", os.environ.get("USE_CLEF", "0")) == "1"
    return on and bool(os.environ.get("CLEF_BASE_URL"))


async def decide(state, questions: dict, images: list[str] | None = None, retries: int = 2) -> dict | None:
    """One /v1/decide call: the raw answers by question key, or None after `retries` failed attempts."""
    if not os.environ.get("CLEF_BASE_URL"):
        return None
    body = {"state": state, "questions": questions}
    if images:
        body["images"] = images[:4]
    url = os.environ["CLEF_BASE_URL"].rstrip("/") + "/v1/decide"
    headers = {"User-Agent": "error404ai-rfq-agent"}
    if os.environ.get("CLEF_API_KEY"):
        headers["Authorization"] = f"Bearer {os.environ['CLEF_API_KEY']}"
    for attempt in range(retries + 1):
        started = time.monotonic()
        try:
            async with _limit, httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=TIMEOUT) as client:
                response = await client.post(url, json=body, headers=headers)
            response.raise_for_status()
            data = response.json()
            tokens = data.get("usage", {}).get("input_tokens", 0)
            USAGE["calls"] += 1
            USAGE["input_tokens"] += tokens
            USAGE["seconds"] += time.monotonic() - started
            print(f"[clef] {response.status_code} {time.monotonic() - started:.1f}s {tokens} tokens", flush=True)
            return data["answers"]
        except Exception as error:
            print(f"[clef] failed ({type(error).__name__}: {str(error)[:120]})", flush=True)
            if attempt < retries:
                await asyncio.sleep(0.5 * (attempt + 1))
    return None


def options_from_view(view: str) -> dict[str, str]:
    """The links and buttons of a page view by ref, each with the words of its row, for a `choice` question."""
    options: dict[str, str] = {}
    lines = view.splitlines()
    for i, line in enumerate(lines):
        matches = list(ELEMENT.finditer(line))
        if not matches:
            continue
        row = ELEMENT.sub(lambda m: m.group(3).strip(), line).strip()
        if len(ELEMENT.sub("", line).strip(" |-")) < 3 and i:  # a row of bare controls: name what precedes it
            row = f"{lines[i - 1].strip()[:120]} / {row}"
        for m in matches:
            options[m.group(1)] = f"{m.group(2)} {m.group(3).strip()}  (row: {row[:240]})"
    return options


async def choose(view: str, goal: str, options: dict[str, str] | None = None) -> tuple[str, float] | None:
    """Which option (by key) best serves `goal` on this view, and Clef's probability for it."""
    options = options or options_from_view(view)
    if not options:
        return None
    answers = await decide({"goal": goal, "page": view[:MAX_STATE]},
                           {"pick": {"type": "choice", "instructions": f"Which element should be used next to reach "
                                     f"the goal: {goal}", "criteria": options}})
    if not answers:
        return None
    pick = answers["pick"]
    return pick["choice"], pick.get("probabilities", {}).get(pick["choice"], pick.get("confidence", 0.0))


async def yes(state, question: str) -> float | None:
    """Clef's probability that the answer to a yes/no question about `state` is yes."""
    answers = await decide(state, {"q": {"type": "noul", "instructions": question}})
    return None if answers is None else answers["q"]["noul"]


async def yes_each(state, questions: list[str]) -> list[float] | None:
    """Several yes/no questions about one state in one call (e.g. one per list row), in order."""
    answers = await decide(state, {f"q{i}": {"type": "noul", "instructions": q} for i, q in enumerate(questions)})
    return None if answers is None else [answers[f"q{i}"]["noul"] for i in range(len(questions))]


OUTCOME_QUESTION = ("Is this page an error, an empty result, a locked or expired state, a dead end or a decoy, rather "
                    "than real content that moves the task on? Last action: {action}")


async def dead_end(view: str, action: str) -> float | None:
    """Clef's probability that `view`, seen after `action`, is an error, empty, locked or decoy page."""
    return await yes({"last_action": action, "page": view[:MAX_STATE]}, OUTCOME_QUESTION.format(action=action))


async def outcome_hint(view: str, action: str) -> str:
    """A line to put above a view when Clef finds it a dead end after `action` (threshold 0.5), else ""."""
    p = await dead_end(view, action) if enabled() else None
    return "" if p is None or p < 0.5 else (f"Check: this looks like an error, empty, locked or decoy page after "
                                             f"{action} (p={p:.2f}); go back or try another way.")


async def page_check(ctx: RunContext, last_action: str) -> str:
    """Ask a fast second opinion whether the current page is an error, empty, locked or decoy page after an action.

    Use it when unsure whether your last action worked, before relying on the page. `last_action` says what you
    did and expected, e.g. "searched the archive for the tender reference".
    """
    session = ctx.deps.session
    p = await dead_end(session.view, last_action)
    session.trace.event(session.name, "clef", check="outcome", action=last_action[:120], p_error=p)
    if p is None:
        return "No second opinion available; judge the page yourself."
    if p >= 0.5:
        return f"Likely an error, empty, locked or decoy page (p={p:.2f}): go back or try another way."
    return f"Likely real content (p_error={p:.2f}); the action seems to have worked."


def tools() -> tuple:
    """Extra worker tools when Clef is on; pass to run_worker(tools=...)."""
    return (page_check,) if enabled() else ()

_limit = asyncio.Semaphore(int(os.environ.get("CLEF_CONCURRENCY", "12")))  # team limit is 16 at once
USAGE = {"calls": 0, "input_tokens": 0, "seconds": 0.0}  # this process's Clef use, for the trace and cost
ELEMENT = re.compile(r"\[(e\d+) (link|button|summary|tab|menuitem)\b([^\]]*)\]")


def enabled() -> bool:
    on = os.environ.get("AGENT_CLEF", os.environ.get("USE_CLEF", "0")) == "1"
    return on and bool(os.environ.get("CLEF_BASE_URL"))


async def decide(state, questions: dict, images: list[str] | None = None, retries: int = 2) -> dict | None:
    """One /v1/decide call: the raw answers by question key, or None after `retries` failed attempts."""
    if not os.environ.get("CLEF_BASE_URL"):
        return None
    body = {"state": state, "questions": questions}
    if images:
        body["images"] = images[:4]
    url = os.environ["CLEF_BASE_URL"].rstrip("/") + "/v1/decide"
    headers = {"User-Agent": "error404ai-rfq-agent"}
    if os.environ.get("CLEF_API_KEY"):
        headers["Authorization"] = f"Bearer {os.environ['CLEF_API_KEY']}"
    for attempt in range(retries + 1):
        started = time.monotonic()
        try:
            async with _limit, httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=TIMEOUT) as client:
                response = await client.post(url, json=body, headers=headers)
            response.raise_for_status()
            data = response.json()
            tokens = data.get("usage", {}).get("input_tokens", 0)
            USAGE["calls"] += 1
            USAGE["input_tokens"] += tokens
            USAGE["seconds"] += time.monotonic() - started
            print(f"[clef] {response.status_code} {time.monotonic() - started:.1f}s {tokens} tokens", flush=True)
            return data["answers"]
        except Exception as error:
            print(f"[clef] failed ({type(error).__name__}: {str(error)[:120]})", flush=True)
            if attempt < retries:
                await asyncio.sleep(0.5 * (attempt + 1))
    return None


def options_from_view(view: str) -> dict[str, str]:
    """The links and buttons of a page view by ref, each with the words of its row, for a `choice` question."""
    options: dict[str, str] = {}
    lines = view.splitlines()
    for i, line in enumerate(lines):
        matches = list(ELEMENT.finditer(line))
        if not matches:
            continue
        row = ELEMENT.sub(lambda m: m.group(3).strip(), line).strip()
        if len(ELEMENT.sub("", line).strip(" |-")) < 3 and i:  # a row of bare controls: name what precedes it
            row = f"{lines[i - 1].strip()[:120]} / {row}"
        for m in matches:
            options[m.group(1)] = f"{m.group(2)} {m.group(3).strip()}  (row: {row[:240]})"
    return options


async def choose(view: str, goal: str, options: dict[str, str] | None = None) -> tuple[str, float] | None:
    """Which option (by key) best serves `goal` on this view, and Clef's probability for it."""
    options = options or options_from_view(view)
    if not options:
        return None
    answers = await decide({"goal": goal, "page": view[:MAX_STATE]},
                           {"pick": {"type": "choice", "instructions": f"Which element should be used next to reach "
                                     f"the goal: {goal}", "criteria": options}})
    if not answers:
        return None
    pick = answers["pick"]
    return pick["choice"], pick.get("probabilities", {}).get(pick["choice"], pick.get("confidence", 0.0))


async def yes(state, question: str) -> float | None:
    """Clef's probability that the answer to a yes/no question about `state` is yes."""
    answers = await decide(state, {"q": {"type": "noul", "instructions": question}})
    return None if answers is None else answers["q"]["noul"]


async def yes_each(state, questions: list[str]) -> list[float] | None:
    """Several yes/no questions about one state in one call (e.g. one per list row), in order."""
    answers = await decide(state, {f"q{i}": {"type": "noul", "instructions": q} for i, q in enumerate(questions)})
    return None if answers is None else [answers[f"q{i}"]["noul"] for i in range(len(questions))]


OUTCOME_QUESTION = ("Is this page an error, an empty result, a locked or expired state, a dead end or a decoy, rather "
                    "than real content that moves the task on? Last action: {action}")


async def dead_end(view: str, action: str) -> float | None:
    """Clef's probability that `view`, seen after `action`, is an error, empty, locked or decoy page."""
    return await yes({"last_action": action, "page": view[:MAX_STATE]}, OUTCOME_QUESTION.format(action=action))


async def outcome_hint(view: str, action: str) -> str:
    """A line to put above a view when Clef finds it a dead end after `action` (threshold 0.5), else ""."""
    p = await dead_end(view, action) if enabled() else None
    return "" if p is None or p < 0.5 else (f"Check: this looks like an error, empty, locked or decoy page after "
                                             f"{action} (p={p:.2f}); go back or try another way.")


async def page_check(ctx: RunContext, last_action: str) -> str:
    """Ask a fast second opinion whether the current page is an error, empty, locked or decoy page after an action.

    Use it when unsure whether your last action worked, before relying on the page. `last_action` says what you
    did and expected, e.g. "searched the archive for the tender reference".
    """
    session = ctx.deps.session
    p = await dead_end(session.view, last_action)
    session.trace.event(session.name, "clef", check="outcome", action=last_action[:120], p_error=p)
    if p is None:
        return "No second opinion available; judge the page yourself."
    if p >= 0.5:
        return f"Likely an error, empty, locked or decoy page (p={p:.2f}): go back or try another way."
    return f"Likely real content (p_error={p:.2f}); the action seems to have worked."


def tools() -> tuple:
    """Extra worker tools when Clef is on; pass to run_worker(tools=...)."""
    return (page_check,) if enabled() else ()

# Who made each model call. Agent.run (patched below) sets LABEL to the agent function that called it: the nearest
# frame in this package outside llm.py and worker.py, or for run_worker the worker kind it set. pydantic-ai makes the
# request in tasks of its own, where the caller's frames are gone but the context variable carries over. USAGE sums
# each label's calls, so the run summary shows where calls, tokens and seconds went (the platform's call list has
# no caller).
LABEL: contextvars.ContextVar[str] = contextvars.ContextVar("llm_label", default="")
USAGE: dict[str, list[float]] = {}  # label -> [calls, input, cached, output, seconds, thinking-on calls]
_PACKAGE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
_NOT_CALLERS = ("llm.py", "worker.py")


def caller() -> str:
    """The agent function the current Agent.run serves (see LABEL)."""
    frame = sys._getframe(1)
    while frame is not None:
        path = frame.f_code.co_filename
        name = os.path.basename(path)
        if name == "worker.py" and LABEL.get():
            return LABEL.get()
        if path.endswith(".py") and os.path.dirname(path) == _PACKAGE and name not in _NOT_CALLERS:
            return f"{name[:-3]}.{frame.f_code.co_name}"
        frame = frame.f_back
    return LABEL.get() or "other"


def _labelled(run):
    @functools.wraps(run)
    async def labelled_run(self, *args, **kwargs):
        token = LABEL.set(caller())
        try:
            return await run(self, *args, **kwargs)
        finally:
            LABEL.reset(token)
    return labelled_run


if not getattr(AbstractAgent.run, "_labelled", False):
    AbstractAgent.run = _labelled(AbstractAgent.run)  # type: ignore[method-assign]
    AbstractAgent.run._labelled = True  # type: ignore[attr-defined]


def record(label: str, response: ModelResponse, seconds: float, thinking: bool) -> None:
    usage = response.usage
    row = USAGE.setdefault(label, [0, 0, 0, 0, 0.0, 0])
    for i, value in enumerate((1, usage.input_tokens, usage.cache_read_tokens, usage.output_tokens, seconds,
                               int(thinking))):
        row[i] += value


def usage_table() -> str:
    """USAGE as lines, most input first, with each label's share of the simulated cost (Qwen's input, cached and
    output prices per token as the platform listed them; only the shares matter)."""
    def cost(row):
        return (row[1] - row[2]) * 0.15 + row[2] * 0.016 + row[3] * 0.47
    total = sum(cost(row) for row in USAGE.values()) or 1.0
    lines = ["calls  think  input  cached  output  seconds  cost%  caller"]
    for label, row in sorted(USAGE.items(), key=lambda item: -cost(item[1])):
        lines.append(f"{row[0]:5.0f} {row[5]:6.0f} {row[1]:6.0f} {row[2]:7.0f} {row[3]:7.0f} {row[4]:8.1f} "
                     f"{100 * cost(row) / total:5.1f}  {label}")
    if FALLBACKS:
        lines.append("hosted fallbacks: " + ", ".join(f"{label} {n}" for label, n in sorted(FALLBACKS.items())))
    return "\n".join(lines)


FALLBACKS: dict[str, int] = {}  # label -> OpenRouter calls that the hosted Qwen answered instead


def _transient(error: ModelAPIError) -> bool:
    """A failure worth another model: no HTTP status (timeout, connection, stall), a 5xx or a 429."""
    status = error.status_code if isinstance(error, ModelHTTPError) else None
    return status is None or status >= 500 or status == 429


class Stalled(Exception):
    """A streamed call stopped making progress (raised by the watchdog, then retried)."""

# Who made each model call. Agent.run (patched below) sets LABEL to the agent function that called it: the nearest
# frame in this package outside llm.py and worker.py, or for run_worker the worker kind it set. pydantic-ai makes the
# request in tasks of its own, where the caller's frames are gone but the context variable carries over. USAGE sums
# each label's calls, so the run summary shows where calls, tokens and seconds went (the platform's call list has
# no caller).
LABEL: contextvars.ContextVar[str] = contextvars.ContextVar("llm_label", default="")
USAGE: dict[str, list[float]] = {}  # label -> [calls, input, cached, output, seconds, thinking-on calls]
_PACKAGE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
_NOT_CALLERS = ("llm.py", "worker.py")


def caller() -> str:
    """The agent function the current Agent.run serves (see LABEL)."""
    frame = sys._getframe(1)
    while frame is not None:
        path = frame.f_code.co_filename
        name = os.path.basename(path)
        if name == "worker.py" and LABEL.get():
            return LABEL.get()
        if path.endswith(".py") and os.path.dirname(path) == _PACKAGE and name not in _NOT_CALLERS:
            return f"{name[:-3]}.{frame.f_code.co_name}"
        frame = frame.f_back
    return LABEL.get() or "other"


def _labelled(run):
    @functools.wraps(run)
    async def labelled_run(self, *args, **kwargs):
        token = LABEL.set(caller())
        try:
            return await run(self, *args, **kwargs)
        finally:
            LABEL.reset(token)
    return labelled_run


if not getattr(AbstractAgent.run, "_labelled", False):
    AbstractAgent.run = _labelled(AbstractAgent.run)  # type: ignore[method-assign]
    AbstractAgent.run._labelled = True  # type: ignore[attr-defined]


def record(label: str, response: ModelResponse, seconds: float, thinking: bool) -> None:
    usage = response.usage
    row = USAGE.setdefault(label, [0, 0, 0, 0, 0.0, 0])
    for i, value in enumerate((1, usage.input_tokens, usage.cache_read_tokens, usage.output_tokens, seconds,
                               int(thinking))):
        row[i] += value


def usage_table() -> str:
    """USAGE as lines, most input first, with each label's share of the simulated cost (Qwen's input, cached and
    output prices per token as the platform listed them; only the shares matter)."""
    def cost(row):
        return (row[1] - row[2]) * 0.15 + row[2] * 0.016 + row[3] * 0.47
    total = sum(cost(row) for row in USAGE.values()) or 1.0
    lines = ["calls  think  input  cached  output  seconds  cost%  caller"]
    for label, row in sorted(USAGE.items(), key=lambda item: -cost(item[1])):
        lines.append(f"{row[0]:5.0f} {row[5]:6.0f} {row[1]:6.0f} {row[2]:7.0f} {row[3]:7.0f} {row[4]:8.1f} "
                     f"{100 * cost(row) / total:5.1f}  {label}")
    if FALLBACKS:
        lines.append("hosted fallbacks: " + ", ".join(f"{label} {n}" for label, n in sorted(FALLBACKS.items())))
    return "\n".join(lines)


FALLBACKS: dict[str, int] = {}  # label -> OpenRouter calls that the hosted Qwen answered instead


def _transient(error: ModelAPIError) -> bool:
    """A failure worth another model: no HTTP status (timeout, connection, stall), a 5xx or a 429."""
    status = error.status_code if isinstance(error, ModelHTTPError) else None
    return status is None or status >= 500 or status == 429


class Stalled(Exception):
    """A streamed call stopped making progress (raised by the watchdog, then retried)."""

lastPrompt: i see 0 cache writes and quite some reads but aparently we are taking quite some time and tokens which leads to more cost

content.text:
Zero cache writes is expected, and caching is not what's driving the cost; the step count is.

**Why writes show 0**
The hosted Qwen caches prompt prefixes automatically. It never bills or reports a separate "write", so the platform only shows reads. Explicit cache writes exist only on the Anthropic backend, which this run didn't use.

**Where the time and tokens go**
The one finished agent run on your portal (the current submission, `run_9d9529b549e4660e`) took 548 model calls, 11.6 minutes and $0.16, for quality 10. Its log shows why:

- **Mail research found almost nothing and kept retrying.** Workers for packaging, condition rules, setup pools and project bonus each hit their 20-request limit with nothing kept, and were then started again. That is roughly 6 of the 9 research minutes.
- **Each worker step resends the page.** A typical mail worker used about 65,000 input tokens over 16–18 requests, of which about 60 % came from the cache.
- **Uncached input is the expensive part.** At the prices in `docs/learned.md` (uncached $0.15/M, cached about $0.016/M, output $0.47/M), the 40 % uncached input costs several times more than all the cached input together.
- **No position was built.** Material selection came back empty for all four positions, so the bid went in with every position omitted.
- **Signing failed.** The model proxy answered 401 at the signing step, so the agent itself never submitted; the 10 points are the platform's score for the run regardless.

So on your portal the agent is spending most of its budget searching for records it doesn't find. That is a generalisation failure, and it costs both quality and money.

**What would actually cut cost**
1. Stop a mail search early when the first pass finds no candidates, instead of running to the limit and retrying.
2. Raise the cache share by keeping the prompt prefix stable between steps; trimming older page views changes the history and breaks the cached prefix.
3. Fewer, larger steps per worker.

The team's own note in `docs/learned.md` says the same: step count times view size is the lever, not caching.

My two comparison runs (plain `main`, and `main` with Clef) are still queued behind teammates' runs, so I don't have their numbers yet. That submission is also older than `main`, so `main` may behave differently. Do you want me to look into the early-stop for empty mail searches once those runs give a baseline?

message.content: when you do evals would you be testing against public data or private ones which we made ?>

content.text:
Against the ones we made. An eval run uses only that eval's own sites, brief and expected answer; it never touches the organizers' public-1 sites or their private dataset.

The three kinds of run use three different datasets:

| Run | Command | Data |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Test run | `atira test-run ./agent` | Organizers' public dataset (public-1) |
| Scored submission | `atira submit ./agent` | Organizers' public dataset (public-1) |
| Eval run | `atira eval run <eval> --package ...` | That eval's own world, written by a team |
| Final run | Started by the organizers | Organizers' private dataset, which nobody can see |

So the runs I started on `err404-synth-hazards-0` are tested against your synth portals, with the expected answer computed by `oracle.py`.

Two wording traps:

- The platform labels eval runs "eval run on the public dataset" in the run details. That label is misleading; the run log shows the agent working on the eval's own site addresses.
- "Private" for an eval only means visibility: private evals are usable by your team alone, public ones by every team. It has nothing to do with the organizers' private dataset.

Your evals are a stand-in for the organizers' private dataset, not a copy of it. A good score on them shows the agent copes with unfamiliar layouts and data, not that it will score the same in the final run.
